messages.text:
Dear Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well.
I am writing to request an update on my recent orders, which, after waiting two months were scheduled to ship last week.

Order details:

Order Number: Order Shop····, Order Shop····
Scheduled Shipment Date: November 14, 2026

As of today, I have not received confirmation regarding the shipment of this order. Could you please confirm whether the order has been shipped? If there have been any delays, I would appreciate an update on the expected shipping time line.

Please note that due to the number of delays already experienced, I am considering alternative options should further delays be anticipated. Your timely update on this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,

Larry D.

The Node Runner LLC

Hi Larry,

You placed these orders on September 24 and 26 and were told they would ship November 14. That date has passed and neither one has shipped. I'm sorry. You've been patient for close to two months, and we should have written to you before the date went by.

Here's where things stand. Shop···· and Shop···· each hold one Magic M. 40T and are both still waiting to ship. All 300 units from this production run are now on their way to our warehouses in the US, Canada and the EU. Yours will go to the US warehouse and ship from there to (address hidden). The realistic ship date for both orders is November 30. You'll get tracking by email for each one as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing on either order has changed. Each one has its 40T and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA. Your $50 code from October is still yours for a future order.

You mentioned you're thinking about other options if there are more delays. Just reply here and tell me what you have in mind, and I'll go through it with you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
